in_marathi.name: Elavarasan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Liberation
in_marathi.long_meaning: Elavarasan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Elavarasan is a Tamil name derived from Elavar, the deity of liberation. The name is composed of three parts: Ela (liberation), vara (boon), and san (protection). Thus, Elavarasan means 'the one who grants liberation and protection'.
